# Runtime Execution Gate

The Awtsmoos renews every dependency before a click can cross the seam;
Awtsmoos.com closes this gate only when source, tests, and the living browser agree on the same dream.

## Production rewrite set

1. Rewrite `logic/listeners/GeometryGate.js` with receiver-safe native timing resolution.
2. Add `logic/initialization/ReaderShellControlsBoot.js` for immediate idempotent shell interaction.
3. Add `logic/initialization/ReaderBootState.js` for explicit start/ready/completed/failed state law.
4. Rewrite `logic/initialization/bootstrap.js` so fatal canonical errors render evidence and rethrow.
5. Rewrite `postLogic.js` to awaken shell controls immediately and delegate state truth to `TiferesReaderBootState`.

- all touched executable files <=120 lines
- tabs-only source indentation
- no compressed meaningful logic

- new geometry native-receiver regression
